about: A wrapping or saturating integer operation never fails: `ticks` is a uint8 from 254 stepped by `wrappingAdd`, so 255 + 1 is 0; `fuel` is a uint8 from 2 stepped down by `saturatingSub`, so 0 - 1 is 0; and the guard `wrappingSub(ticks, 250) < 10` is 7 at 1, so `probe` ends the machine. None raises error.execution, so `refusals` stays 0. Expected values are derived from the document and the definition of the operations (docs/adr/0063, section 1), not observed from a backend.

steps.note: the variables start at their declared values
and the count goes on from the wrap
wrappingSub(1, 250) is 7 (mod 256), below 10, so the guard is true, raises nothing, and takes the transition into the final `near`; a machine that ended has no state to read
